root_idea.summary: The root centers on exposure to sunlight and the spreading of daylight, especially the forenoon and its brightness.
root_idea.development: From the experience of being exposed to the sun, the root names the forenoon and sunlight, and extends to apparentness, open or sun-exposed places, and actions performed during that time.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I citation form ضَحِيَ.
Displayed as the principal nominal headword ضُحًى.
The T-tagged occurrences are temporal-adverbial uses of the same lexical item ضُحًى, not a separate public headword.

senses.definition: To be exposed to the sun; to be struck by its heat.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction لا تَضْحَىٰ, it describes being subjected to the sun's heat, in contrast with being protected from it.

senses.definition: The early forenoon or daylight period after sunrise, as the sun spreads and the day advances.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a temporal noun and adverbial expression for the forenoon or daylight period.

senses.definition: The sunlight or brightness associated with the forenoon.
senses.usage_conditions: In ضُحَى الشَّمْسِ and related Quranic expressions, the word denotes the sun's light or brightness rather than merely the time of day.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appear or become apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression ضَحَا الطَّرِيقُ, said of a road becoming visible or distinct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cloudless.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a night that clears of clouds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become white or predominantly white.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a horse whose whiteness predominates over its blackness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perish or die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression in which a person's shade becomes sun and therefore disappears.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth into the sunshine or expose oneself to sunlight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used with لِلشَّمْسِ for going out into the sun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sweat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical usage with the imperfect يَضْحَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come to someone during the time of the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A temporal Form II use, comparable to coming in the morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture livestock in the forenoon, or to feed people a morning meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of grazing sheep, goats, or camels during ضُحًى and of providing or inviting people to the corresponding meal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act gently, deliberately, or without haste.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the proverbial expression ضَحِّ رُوَيْدًا, it can also imply slaughtering or sacrificing deliberately and without haste.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To slaughter or sacrifice an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sacrifice is conventionally associated with the time of ضُحًى and the days of sacrifice, though the verb may be used for the act during those days more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become exposed to the sun, with vegetation consequently drying up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of lands or countries whose exposure to the sun dries their herbage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter upon the time of the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A time-of-day verb, comparable to أَصْبَحَ for entering the morning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become occupied with, set about, or begin doing something during the first part of the day.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Like other time-of-day verbs, it may be rendered simply as “became” when followed by an imperfect verb or participle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform the supererogatory prayer associated with the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage referring to the prayer of ضُحَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw or go far away from an affair or from water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person withdrawing from an affair and of birds going far from water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something apparent, show it, or reveal it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can be transitive with an object or used with عَنْ to make an affair manifest.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deprive someone of protection or compassion, or to cause someone's protective presence to disappear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative use of going out from shade into the sun; it can also allude to death or loss.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To eat during the forenoon or eat the morning meal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Comparable to تَغَدَّى, with emphasis on eating at the time called ضُحًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sun.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transferred use based on the sun's appearance during the period called ضُحًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Perspicuity or plainness of meaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the expression مَا لِكَلَامِهِ ضُحًى, used figuratively of speech or poetry lacking clarity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Exposed to the sun or growing under its direct exposure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to sun-exposed places and objects, including a mountain top or a staff matured and hardened in the sun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who eats during the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional noun for one who eats at the time called ضُحًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The later forenoon period, approaching midday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The period after ضُحًى, when the day is high or the sun has risen substantially.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The morning meal, and by extension pasture eaten at that time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Named from the time in which the food or pasture is taken.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An outer or exposed place or tract, especially one open to the sun or lacking shade.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an exterior place, an unenclosed land, and an exposed desert or tree; the term may describe a place with no protective shade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The exposed or visible side of the head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression بَدَا بِضَاحِي رَأْسِهِ, to appear or show that side of the head.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An outer, exterior, or exposed side, region, or tract of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: By extension, it denotes outer districts, people living outside a town, open-country palm trees, projecting body parts, the sides of a watering-trough, and the heavens.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Openly or in the open.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In فَعَلَهُ ضَاحِيَةً, the adverb describes doing something openly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Livestock that drink during the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to cattle, sheep, or goats drinking at the time called ضُحًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gray or predominantly white in color.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a horse; the feminine form describes a corresponding mare or other feminine noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bright, clear, or shining.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a cloudless night or bright day, and also to the brightness of a moon, lamp, or wick.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or member of a people, in the idiomatic expression أَيُّ الضَّحْيَاءِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This meaning belongs to the cited idiom and is not a general meaning of the temporal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The collective sacrificial victims, and hence the day or festival of sacrifice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The masculine form may denote the day of sacrifice, while the collective noun denotes the sacrificial victims.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A plant resembling chamomile.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plant name recorded as a separate lexical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep, goat, camel, bovine, or other animal slaughtered as a sacrifice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Traditionally slaughtered during the time of ضُحًى on the day of sacrifice; the term also has the listed plural forms أَضَاحِيّ and ضَحَايَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land from which the sun is hardly or never absent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exposed tract receiving continuous or nearly continuous sunlight.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person entering upon the time of the forenoon.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial noun for one who reaches or enters the period called ضُحًى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose pubic hair does not grow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine usage describing a woman whose عَانَة is bare of hair.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Its become/commence construction is covered by the broader engagement meaning.
Pointer and inflectional usage note; no independent lexical branch.
Participial identification without an independent lexical branch.
The no-shade specialization is covered by the exposed-place meaning.

cautions: The Quranic verb تَضْحَىٰ is normalized under ضَحِيَ because the supplied Quran-focused lexical discussion gives ضَحِيَ يَضْحَى; Lane also records a closely related ضَحَا form in the same sun-exposure branch.
The nominal and T-tagged Quran groups share the public headword ضُحًى, with the T-tagged occurrences treated as temporal-adverbial uses rather than a separate lexical item.
